landing.badge: Free forever · Anime coaches · Global community
landing.subtitle: Free home and gym workouts guided by an original cast of anime-style coaches — with voice coaching, XP, belts and a worldwide community to train with.
landing.coachesSubtitle: Eight original characters, each with their own specialty, personality and voice. Pick one — switch any time.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to level up
landing.f1Body: Six phases that genuinely get harder — at home with no equipment, with dumbbells, or in a full gym.
landing.f2Body: Your coach counts you in, calls the rests and cheers your personal records — with sound, voice and vibration cues.
landing.f3Body: Every workout earns XP. Climb from White Belt to Legend and unlock badges along the way.
landing.f4Body: Chat with people training around the world, share your wins and climb the leaderboard.
landing.f5Body: 30-day challenges that grow a little every day — push-ups, squats, planks, grip and more.
landing.f6Body: Anime fan or not: clear instructions, 12 languages, metric or imperial, and an installable app.
landing.modeHomeBody: Bodyweight only — a chair, a towel, a backpack.
landing.modeDbBody: One pair of dumbbells unlocks a whole new tier.
landing.modeGymBody: Barbells, cables and machines with real strength progressions.
landing.a1: Yes. Every workout, coach, Training Arc and the community are free.
landing.q2: Do I need to like anime?
landing.a2: Not at all. The coaches add personality and fun, but the training is real: clear instructions, sets, reps, rest timers and progress tracking.
landing.a3: No. The home program uses only bodyweight. If you have dumbbells or a gym, switch modes any time for heavier training.
landing.q4: I'm a complete beginner. Can I start?
landing.a4: Yes. Phase 1 starts with the easiest variations and the program grows with you.
landing.a5: You can install Level Up Dojo to your phone's home screen straight from your browser, and it keeps working offline.
landing.a6: The community has clear rules, message reporting, blocking and moderators. You must be 13 or older to chat.
landing.q7: Are the coaches from an anime?
landing.a7: No — they're an original cast created for Level Up Dojo, so you'll meet them here first.
landing.finalTitle: Your first level-up is one workout away.
landing.finalBody: Free. No equipment needed. Your coach is waiting.
landing.footer: Level Up Dojo — free workouts for anime fans and everyone else.

auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.

dashboard.hydrationHint: Tap a glass to log it. Use − / + to change your goal.
dashboard.missedBody: Pick up where you left off — your schedule shifts so today becomes Day {day}. Nothing you've logged is lost.
dashboard.quickSubtitle: Grab a quick workout — it still earns XP.
dashboard.communityBody: Share today's win, ask for advice or just say hi.

player.resumed: Picked up where you left off.
player.readyBody: You hit the top of the rep range on every set of {names}. Next time, add 1–2 reps or slow down the lowering phase.
player.shareError: Could not share — join the community first.

train.title: Train
train.subtitle: Quick workouts for any day, and 30-day Training Arcs.

arcs.intro: 30-day challenges that get a little harder every day. Every 7th day is a rest day.
arcs.restToday: Rest day — recover and come back tomorrow.
arcs.finishedBody: You finished {name}. Start it again or pick a new arc.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.subtitle: Pick the coach who guides your workouts and cheers you on. You can switch any time.
coaches.original: All coaches are original characters created for Level Up Dojo.

community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Train together. Chat, share wins and climb the leaderboard.
community.setupBody: Pick a username and an avatar. Your username, avatar, level and country (if you add one) are public; your email and training details stay private.
community.usernameTaken: That username is taken — try another.
community.rule1: Be kind. No harassment, hate speech or bullying.
community.rule2: Keep it safe for everyone — no adult or violent content.
community.rule3: Never share personal info like your address, school or phone number.
community.rule5: Encourage, don't judge. Never pressure anyone about their body or weight.
community.ageConfirm: I am 13 years old or older
community.rulesAccept: I agree to follow the dojo rules
community.reportBody: Moderators will review it. The sender isn't told who reported them.
community.reportSent: Thanks — a moderator will review it.
community.blocked: {name} is blocked. You won't see their messages.
community.slowDown: You're sending messages too fast — wait a few seconds.
community.tooLong: Messages can be up to 1,000 characters.
community.notSetup: The community isn't set up on the server yet.
community.notSetupBody: Run the community section of supabase/schema.sql in your Supabase project, then reload this page.
community.leaderboardSubtitle: Ranked by total XP. Updates as people train.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, coach, preferences and data.
settings.coachDesc: Your coach guides workouts, greets you on the dashboard and appears on your share cards.
settings.soundDesc: Beeps for the last 3 seconds and when a timer ends
settings.voiceDesc: Your coach reads out each exercise, set and rest period
settings.vibrationDesc: Buzzes when a set or rest ends (phones only)
settings.trainingModeDesc: Which version of the 365-day program you follow. Switching keeps all your progress.
settings.regionDesc: Shows budget meal ideas built from foods common where you live.
settings.reminderDesc: Add a repeating reminder to your calendar. It alerts you every day and links straight to that day's workout.
settings.reminderNativeDesc: Get a notification on this phone every day at the time you choose.
settings.reminderDenied: Notifications are turned off for this app in your phone settings.
settings.calendarHint: Open the downloaded file to add the reminder to your calendar.
settings.startDateHint: Moving this shifts which program day is "today". Workouts you've logged stay attached to their day number.
settings.startDateError: Could not update the start date.
settings.startDateFuture: Pick a start date that is today or earlier.
settings.dataDesc: Download a copy of everything you've logged.
settings.resetBody: Clears all workout history, measurements, strength tests and habit data, and restarts the program at Day 1 today. Your preferences are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetDone: Progress reset — Day 1 starts today. Refreshing…
settings.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account, all progress, your progress photos and your community profile and messages. Type DELETE to confirm.
settings.deleteError: Could not delete your account. The delete_own_account function may not be set up yet.

pages.nutritionSubtitle: Budget-friendly, protein-forward meals built for growth.

onboarding.title: Welcome to the Dojo
onboarding.step1Body: Your coach guides every workout with their own voice and personality. You can switch any time.
onboarding.step2Body: Pick the program that matches your gear. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.mode_dumbbells: A pair of dumbbells at home.
onboarding.step3Body: Optional — record today's numbers so you can see how far you've come.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: This page hasn't been saved for offline use yet. Pages you've opened before still work, and anything you log is kept on this device and syncs as soon as you're back online.

install.title: Put Level Up Dojo on your home screen
install.body: Opens full-screen like an app, starts faster and works offline.
install.iosBody: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. It opens full-screen like an app and works offline.
